entities.summary: In statistics, regression toward the mean is the phenomenon where if one sample of a random variable is extreme, the next sampling of the same random variable is likely to be closer to its mean. Furthermore, when many random variables are sampled and the most extreme results are intentionally picked out, it refers to the fact that a second sampling of these picked-out variables will result in "less extreme" results, closer to the initial mean of all of the variables.
